summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong coverage of core requirements. Covers all major functions (parsing, bumping, changelog generation, file I/O, CLI), validates GitHub Actions workflow structure via actionlint, and runs end-to-end pipeline tests through act. Test organization is clear with separate concerns (unit tests, workflow structure, integration). Good edge case coverage including breaking changes via both ! marker and BREAKING CHANGE footer, nested JSON fields, multi-line commits, and various error scenarios. Tests are independent using temporary directories and helper functions. Minor gaps: some boundary conditions untested (e.g., zero-versions, empty commit files, invalid git ranges), and the act-harness test is complex. The fixture files are referenced but not shown in provided code—however, workflow-structure.test.ts validates they exist, so they must be present for tests to pass. Would reliably catch regressions in core logic and CI/CD integration.
